claim_scope.note: Internal lane. Measured up to 8000 events on one loaded aarch64 workstation. The historical ~1.0-1.6s warm figure came from a ~78k-event store that has not been reproduced, so no <300ms claim may be made at that scale from this run. Publishing any latency number requires a run at the scale being claimed.

reproducibility.note: Wall-clock timings are hardware- and load-dependent and will not reproduce byte-identically. The seeded corpus and query are deterministic; the scaling shape across sizes is the comparable part, not the absolute milliseconds.

scoring.judge_note: No judge and no provider calls; this lane measures latency only.
scoring.method: wall-clock warm Memory Checkout p50/p95, interleaved within one process per store size
